security_audit.summary: Static findings were false positives after context review. The apparent command, network, reconnaissance, and traversal signals are Markdown links, metadata, examples, or report-writing prose. One medium semantic risk remains because the dynamic report filename lacks an explicit slugging and path containment rule.

remediation.issue: Dynamic report filename is not constrained.
remediation.suggestion: Slug the topic to safe characters and verify the resolved path stays under the intended report directory.

semantic_findings.title: Unvalidated Dynamic Report Filename
semantic_findings.description: The save instruction uses `YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>.md` without saying to slug the topic or reject path separators. A crafted topic could redirect the output outside the intended memory folder if the host follows it literally.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The line clearly defines a dynamic filename, but the exact source of `<topic>` and host path safeguards are not shown. I kept this as a medium-confidence context finding.

content.value_statement: Campaign results are hard to translate for executives, clients, and internal teams. This skill turns supplied metrics into audience-specific reports with narrative, tables, visuals, and recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Selects executive, client, team, or board framing from the requested audience.
Turns supplied reach, engagement, conversion, spend, revenue, ROI, and ROAS metrics into report sections.
Builds summary, results, learning, recommendation, and action item sections from included templates.
Recommends chart types for ROI, goal progress, budget allocation, engagement, and trend data.
Can save finished reports to documented memory paths when file writes are available.
limitations: Does not calculate raw ROI or ROAS from financial inputs.
Requires campaign metrics from the user or prior analysis output.
Does not independently verify social platform, CRM, or analytics data.
Repository cross-links may be unavailable when the skill is installed alone.

use_cases.title: Brief leadership after a campaign
use_cases.description: Create an executive report that highlights ROI, revenue, strategic takeaways, and budget recommendations.

use_cases.title: Deliver client-facing results
use_cases.description: Prepare a polished performance report with goals, delivered outcomes, top content, audience insights, and next steps.

use_cases.title: Run an internal retrospective
use_cases.description: Build a detailed team report that compares targets, explains performance, and assigns optimization actions.

prompt_templates.title: Basic executive report
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when leadership needs a short campaign outcome summary.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an executive campaign report for [campaign]. Use these metrics: [metrics]. Focus on ROI, reach, revenue, and next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Client performance report
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when an agency needs a client-ready campaign recap.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a client performance report for [campaign] covering [period]. Include goals, delivered results, top content, audience insights, and recommendations.

prompt_templates.title: Internal team retrospective
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when the team needs operational learnings after delivery.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an internal team retrospective for [campaign]. Compare results to targets, list top performers, identify gaps, and assign action items.

prompt_templates.title: Board portfolio summary
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when senior stakeholders need portfolio-level decisions.
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a board summary for [campaign portfolio]. Compare campaigns, highlight business impact, note risks, and recommend budget changes for next quarter.

output_examples.input: Create an executive report with spend, revenue, reach, and ROAS metrics.
output: A concise executive summary centered on ROI, ROAS, revenue, and reach.
A results table comparing targets with actual outcomes.
A recommendation for the next budget and creator mix.

output_examples.input: Build a client report for a finished influencer campaign.
output: A campaign overview with objectives, strategy, execution, and delivered results.
Sections for content performance, influencer performance, audience insights, and recommendations.
A clear next steps section for client follow-up.

output_examples.input: Prepare an internal team report for quarterly campaign learning.
output: A detailed performance review by objective, platform, creator, content format, and cost metric.
A learning table that links evidence to future action.
An action item list with owners, deadlines, and status.

best_practices: Provide final metrics before asking for the report.
State the target audience and reporting period in the first request.
Review saved reports for confidential client data before sharing.
anti_patterns: Asking the skill to calculate ROI from raw finance data.
Requesting one report for every audience without prioritizing key decisions.
Using metrics without targets, benchmarks, or prior period context.

faq.question: Can this skill calculate ROI?
faq.answer: No. It uses ROI and ROAS values supplied by the user or another analysis skill.

faq.question: What audiences does it support?
faq.answer: It supports executive, client, internal team, and board reports.

faq.question: Does it require live data connectors?
faq.answer: No. It can work from pasted metrics. Connectors are optional when the host provides them.

faq.question: What does the output include?
faq.answer: Outputs usually include an executive summary, metric tables, narrative insights, recommendations, and action items.

faq.question: Can it create paid ads reports?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill states it can present paid ads reporting from existing measurement history.

faq.question: Where are reports saved?
faq.answer: The skill documents memory paths for influencer and paid ads reports when file writes are allowed.
